literature_reference.title: ConvNeXt V2: Co-Designing and Scaling ConvNets With Masked Autoencoders

implementation_source: timm port with official Meta ConvNeXt-V2 lineage
parameter_count_reference: ~28.6M; exact instantiated count captured by server
base_preprocessing: RSNA DICOM slope/intercept -> MONOCHROME1 inversion -> per-image minmax -> PIL bilinear 224x224 -> repeat grayscale to 3 channels
augmentation: development-only horizontal flip p=0.5, brightness delta ±0.15, contrast factor 0.85-1.15
inner_validation: 10% stratified from each outer-train set; seed=42+fold
threshold_selection: canonical tune_threshold grid 0.01..0.99 / 197 points; maximize Youden subject to sensitivity >=0.85; deterministic tie-break
final_refit_rule: round(median(best_epoch_across_5_outer_folds)); train full development for exactly that many epochs

statistical_comparisons.primary: paired DeLong A8 minus baseline ROC-AUC
